# AGRO MIRAI

> AI-driven smart agriculture advisory system for Indian farms. Generates crop
> recommendations, irrigation advisories, and disease-risk alerts from a
> field's real soil, weather, and satellite data, and delivers them back to
> the farmer by voice in English, Kannada, Telugu, or Hindi.

AGRO MIRAI is a BITM Department of AIML (VTU Semester 7) capstone project.
It is not a generic AI demo — every figure on the site comes from a
committed, held-out model evaluation, and known limitations are disclosed
rather than hidden.

## What it does

- **Crop recommendation** — a RandomForest classifier trained on soil N/P/K,
  pH, and 14/30-day weather aggregates, ranking 22 crop types for a field,
  with a regional-suitability check (Bellary/Karnataka) that flags
  agronomically unusual picks instead of silently trusting the model.
- **Irrigation advisory** — a physically grounded water balance: reference
  evapotranspiration (Hargreaves-Samani, FAO-56) times a crop coefficient by
  growth stage, minus recent rainfall, giving a recommended irrigation depth
  in millimetres. A separately trained classifier sets urgency.
- **Disease risk detection** — a MobileNetV2 CNN trained on the PlantVillage
  dataset reads an uploaded leaf photo when available; otherwise a
  transparent, weighted rule-based score over humidity, rainfall,
  temperature, and NDVI trend fills in. A failed CNN call always falls back
  to the rule-based score, never a hard failure.
- **Voice in four Indian languages** — advisories translate and speak back in
  English, Kannada, Telugu, and Hindi, with name+phone+OTP login (no
  passwords).

## Measured results

- Crop recommendation accuracy: 99.55% (RandomForest, held-out split,
  macro-F1 0.9955).
- Disease CNN validation accuracy: 99.24% (MobileNetV2 on PlantVillage,
  38 classes) — evaluated against lab-condition photos, not field
  conditions; documented, not hidden.
- Irrigation urgency classifier accuracy: 72.4% (3-class RandomForest,
  macro-F1 0.58).

## Key pages

- [Landing page](https://agromirai.vercel.app/): product overview, model
  results, and how the pipeline works end to end.
